user_report: Floating windows repeatedly appeared and the flow ended before user action.
observed_screen: Display settings with Click target-not-found recovery card and retry/pause/stop controls.
findings: The font menu row on the Display page was used as context for its unrelated brightness slider.
This made the rule classifier report the font control screen and offered both navigation and adjustment to Jev.
The observed live responses did not report successful technical completion. The displayed card was recovery, not success.
The earlier physical font test opened the font page before starting the app request, so it did not cover this navigation boundary.
change: Exclude menu/control labels and contained list text from unnamed slider context.
For font-size tasks, require graph selector identity or independent page context before offering an adjustment slider to Jev.
regression_cases: Display page remains Display with or without hierarchy and after brightness text is filtered.
Jev receives font-menu navigation without an unrelated slider candidate.
Display navigation precedes actual font control consent; unchanged observations cannot complete; a correlated adjustment plus changed slider and FONT_SCALE can complete.
